Musician.description: A player, conductor or librarian of the orchestra. A first name alone is not an identity.

Piece.description: A work in the repertoire, independent of who plays it.

Assignment.description:
Which part a player holds in a piece: soloist, section principal or understudy covering another player.
Covering a part is not holding it.

Tutelage.description: A bond between two players: one teaches the other, or the two share a music stand.

Rehearsal.description: One rehearsal call for a piece. booked_by set it up, conductor leads it, absentee missed it.

Fee.description: Money the orchestra owes a player for a concert; paid_state says whether it has gone out.

questions.q: Who is the soloist for Lantern Suite?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)-[:soloist]->(n1:Musician) WHERE n0.opus_title = 'Lantern Suite' RETURN n1.artist AS artist

questions.speaker: mateus_l
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)-[:covered]->(n1:Piece) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.opus_title AS opus_title

questions.speaker: ravi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)-[:teacher]->(n1:Musician) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.artist AS artist

questions.q: Who is the pupil of Dagny Hovland?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)-[:pupil]->(n1:Musician) WHERE n0.artist = 'Dagny Hovland' RETURN n1.artist AS artist

questions.q: Who is the deskmate of Ravi Subramaniam?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)-[:deskmate]->(n1:Musician) WHERE n0.artist = 'Ravi Subramaniam' RETURN n1.artist AS artist

questions.q: Is there a record that the Seven Bells Overture rehearsal was recorded?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)<-[:piece]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.opus_title = 'Seven Bells Overture' RETURN coalesce(n1.recorded, false) AS recorded

questions.q: Was the Tidewater Concerto rehearsal recorded?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)<-[:piece]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.opus_title = 'Tidewater Concerto' RETURN n1.recorded AS recorded

questions.q: How many minutes did the rehearsals I conducted last?
questions.speaker: benedikt
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)<-[:conductor]-(n1:Rehearsal) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.minutes_long AS minutes_long

questions.q: Who was absent from the rehearsals booked by Mateus Lindqvist?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)<-[:booked_by]-(n1:Rehearsal)-[:absentee]->(n2:Musician) WHERE n0.artist = 'Mateus Lindqvist' RETURN n2.artist AS artist

questions.q: How much is the fee for Ilse Vermeulen?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)<-[:payee]-(n1:Fee) WHERE n0.artist = 'Ilse Vermeulen' RETURN n1.amount_euros AS amount_euros

questions.q: What amount is each fee and is it owed or paid?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fee) RETURN n0.amount_euros AS amount_euros, n0.paid_state AS paid_state

questions.q: Who conducted the rehearsal in the hall annex?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal)-[:conductor]->(n1:Musician) WHERE n0.venue_note = 'hall annex' RETURN n1.artist AS artist

questions.q: What status does the rehearsal at the chapel have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Rehearsal) WHERE n0.venue_note CONTAINS 'chapel' RETURN n0.status AS status

questions.q: What is the email of Ilse Vermeulen?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician) WHERE n0.artist = 'Ilse Vermeulen' RETURN n0.email AS email

questions.q: Who is principal for Harrow Variations?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Piece)-[:principal]->(n1:Musician) WHERE n0.opus_title = 'Harrow Variations' RETURN n1.artist AS artist

questions.q: Which pieces has Benedikt Krauss led?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Musician)-[:led]->(n1:Piece) WHERE n0.artist = 'Benedikt Krauss' RETURN n1.opus_title AS opus_title
